parts.label: (b)
parts.answer: The graph is the reflection of $y=f(x)$ in the $x$-axis followed by a vertical stretch of factor $2$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Official sketch of $y=g(x)$ on the supplied axes for $0\leq x\leq\pi$: the curve starts below the $x$-axis at $(0,-4)$, rises through the axis to its maximum $(\tfrac14\pi,2)$, falls through the axis to its minimum $(\tfrac34\pi,-10)$, then rises to finish below the axis at $(\pi,-4)$. This is the graph of $f$ reflected in the $x$-axis and stretched by factor $2$ in the $y$ direction — B2, 1.
No asymptote is present in the official sketch.
Total: 2
